# TriageAI Evaluation Report

**This report is machine-generated by `eval/run_evaluation.py` and reflects only what that run actually measured. No number here is a target, a claim, or copied from elsewhere.**

- LLM provider used for this run: `fake`
- Dataset: 60 synthetic tickets, 10 synthetic KB docs (synthetic (generated by scripts/generate_synthetic_tickets.py, not real user data))
- Runs completed: 60 / 60

## Metrics

| Metric | Value | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| Classification accuracy | 76.7% | predicted category == synthetic ground-truth category |
| Retrieval recall@k | 100.0% | expected KB doc appears anywhere in retrieved evidence |
| Retrieval MRR | 0.406 | mean reciprocal rank of the expected KB doc in retrieved evidence |
| Groundedness rate | 76.7% | fraction of drafts with zero unsupported claims (v1 citation+lexical-overlap heuristic) |
| Hallucination rate | 23.3% | 1 - groundedness rate, by the same heuristic |
| Mean supported-claim ratio | 88.3% | average fraction of a draft's sentences that were grounded |
| Escalation precision | 100.0% | of tickets routed to human review, fraction with a genuine reason per our own routing policy (misclassified, high-risk category, or ungrounded) |
| Escalation recall | 61.8% | of tickets with a genuine reason to escalate, fraction actually routed to human review |
| Latency (mean / p50 / p95 / max) | 99.4ms / 96.9ms / 124.5ms / 133.6ms | end-to-end pipeline.run() wall-clock time |

## Known limitations of this measurement

- Dataset is synthetic and template-generated (see `scripts/generate_synthetic_tickets.py`), not real support tickets — these numbers describe pipeline correctness on a controlled dataset, not production performance.
- Classification/drafting used the deterministic **fake** provider (keyword rules), not a real LLM — this run validates pipeline wiring, not LLM classification/generation quality. Re-run with `TRIAGEAI_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama` once Ollama is installed for LLM-quality numbers.
- Groundedness/hallucination detection uses a citation-and-lexical-overlap heuristic (`domain/groundedness.py`), not an NLI model — see `docs/architecture.md` for that trade-off.
